originals.citation: de Mello, R., Teixeira, E., Schots, M., Werner, C., & Travassos, G. (2012). Checklist-based inspection technique for feature models review. Sixth Brazilian Symposium on Software Components, Architectures and Reuse (SBCARS), 140-149.

de Mello, R. M., Teixeira, E. N., Schots, M., Werner, C. M. L., & Travassos, G. H. (2014). Verification of software product line artifacts: A checklist to support feature model inspections. Journal of Universal Computer Science, 20(5), 720-745.

quote: We conducted an operational replication of the quasi-experiment designed to evaluate the feasibility of FMCheck [de Mello et al. 2012]. ... As a result, it was observed that FMCheck was significantly more effective, identifying 51.3% more defects than ad-hoc inspections [de Mello et al. 2014].
notes: One original study (the first FMCheck quasi-experiment, 14 COPPE/UFRJ students) reported in two papers, both cited for it: the SBCARS 2012 paper (on list) and the 2014 J.UCS article (not on list), which the replication cites most often for the first study's results. Listed both per the two-reports rule.
